verdict.rationale: Crossmint's agent features are APIs that let developers' own agents pay and check out under user-defined spending rules. Agent Checkouts runs a narrow purchase flow through an API. The 'AI assistants' page only covers feeding the docs into external code helpers such as Cursor or Copilot. None of the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant inside the Crossmint product that users can hand general tasks to, so the evidence does not deliver this applicable story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
